title: Junior Laravel Developer
description: Join our backend team and build APIs and admin panels with Laravel.
requirements: Good knowledge of PHP and Laravel basics. Familiar with MySQL and Git.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain Laravel features. Write migrations, models and tests. Fix bugs reported by QA.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description: Lead the development of our SaaS platform from database to UI.
requirements: 5+ years with PHP/Laravel and a modern JS framework. Experience with Docker and CI.
responsibilities: Design architecture, review code, mentor juniors and own delivery of major features.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Learn on real datasets while supporting our analytics team.
requirements: Studying CS, statistics or similar. Basic Python and SQL.
responsibilities: Clean data, build simple dashboards and prepare weekly reports.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build and deploy ML models for recommendation and matching features.
requirements: 3+ years in Python and ML. Experience deploying models to production.
responsibilities: Train and evaluate models, build data pipelines and monitor model quality.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Design clean and modern interfaces for web and mobile products.
requirements: Strong portfolio. Hands-on with Figma and design systems.
responsibilities: Create wireframes and prototypes, run quick user tests and hand off designs to developers.

title: SEO & Content Specialist
description: Grow organic traffic for our clients through content and technical SEO.
requirements: Experience with SEO tools. Excellent writing in Arabic and English.
responsibilities: Plan content calendars, write articles and report on rankings monthly.

title: Freelance Social Media Manager
description: Manage social accounts for a portfolio of retail brands.
requirements: Proven social media campaigns and basic design skills.
responsibilities: Schedule posts, answer comments and deliver monthly performance reports.

title: Warehouse Operations Coordinator
description: Coordinate daily inbound and outbound operations in our Alexandria warehouse.
requirements: Bachelor degree. Good Excel skills and ability to work in shifts.
responsibilities: Track shipments, manage the warehouse team schedule and report KPIs.

title: Customer Support Agent
description: Help customers track their orders and solve delivery issues.
requirements: Fluent Arabic, good English. Calm and clear communication.
responsibilities: Answer calls and chats, log tickets and escalate complex cases.
